# BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and Large Language Models

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Junnan Li, Dongxu Li, Silvio Savarese, Steven Hoi  
**Year:** 2022  
**Journal:** ICML  
**DOI:** [10.48550/arXiv.2301.12597](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2301.12597)  
**Publisher:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.12597](https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.12597)

**Keywords:** blip-2, vision-language

## Abstract

We propose BLIP-2 a generic and efficient pre-training strategy that bootstraps vision-language pre-training from off-the-shelf frozen pre-trained image encoders and frozen large language models.
